fields.title: Sri Lanka Treasury procurement notice record
fields.description: One record per notice. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_CURRENT (mode=latest, from the Ministry's own structured notice-management system) or TENDER_ARCHIVE (mode=archive, from the historical CMS listing, raw HTML-embedded content going back to 2018). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a fetch fails.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'latest' for current-notice records, or 'archive:page<N>' for archive records / errors.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-current-notices, S1-archive, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: Total notices the site reports for this view (all currently-open notices for TENDER_CURRENT; the full historical archive count for TENDER_ARCHIVE), before any maxResults truncation.

_page.title: Archive page
_page.description: TENDER_ARCHIVE only -- which archive page (1 = most recent) this record came from.

id.title: Notice ID
id.description: The Ministry's internal ID for this notice. Numeric for TENDER_CURRENT; either a numeric string or a dated reference code (e.g. '20210610004') for TENDER_ARCHIVE.

title.title: Issuing department
title.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- the government department/ministry that posted this notice, e.g. 'Department of Management Services'.

subtitle.title: Notice title
subtitle.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- the notice's own title/summary.

description.title: Description (raw HTML)
description.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- raw HTML fragment with contract/IFB reference numbers etc., exactly as the Ministry entered it.

descriptionText.title: Description (plain text)
descriptionText.description: Convenience field: the notice's HTML content (description for TENDER_CURRENT, descriptionHtml for TENDER_ARCHIVE) with tags stripped.

descriptionHtml.title: Description (raw HTML)
descriptionHtml.description: TENDER_ARCHIVE only -- raw HTML fragment containing the full notice text (department, bid/reference numbers, items, closing date), exactly as published. Field set and formatting are not standardized across notices -- this is intentional raw passthrough of a genuinely free-form CMS field.

label.title: Issuing department (archive)
label.description: TENDER_ARCHIVE only -- the government department/ministry, as labeled in the archive.

status.title: Status flag
status.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- whether the notice is currently published (true/false).

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- internal Ministry staff email that created the notice.

createdOn.title: Created on
createdOn.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- raw timestamp string as shown by the site.

publishedOn.title: Published on
publishedOn.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- raw timestamp string as shown by the site.

updatedOn.title: Updated on
updatedOn.description: TENDER_CURRENT only -- raw timestamp string as shown by the site.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Downloadable documents (bidding documents, addenda, notices), each with a title and a resolved downloadUrl. TENDER_ARCHIVE attachments occasionally 404 if the Ministry has since removed an old file -- the metadata itself is always accurate.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
